paths.path: ~/.config/citron/qt-config.ini (ConfigDir = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/citron, default ~/.config/citron; a portable user/ dir next to the binary takes priority) — controller mappings live in its [Controls] section. Each button/axis value is a serialized ParamPackage such as engine:keyboard,code:<integer>,toggle:0 or engine:sdl,joystick:<id>,button:<n>; axis mappings use engine:sdl,joystick:<id>,axis:<n>,direction:<positive|negative>. ParamPackage uses comma-separated key:value pairs with $0/$1/$2 escaping; named profiles are separate ini files at ~/.config/citron/input/<profile>.ini
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp POSIX branch — portable user/ dir wins, else GetDataDirectory("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") / CITRON_DIR (fallback home/.config)

paths.path: ~/.local/share/citron/nand/user/save/ ($XDG_DATA_HOME/citron/nand/user/save) — account saves at account/<128-bit user UUID hex>/<title id upper 16 hex>/0/, device saves at device/<title id 16 hex>/0/; SD card game data sits separately in ~/.local/share/citron/sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space, e.g. user/save/account/<uuid>/<000000000000B000>/0/; the GUI also recognises the legacy user/save/0000000000000000 layout

paths.path: ~/.local/share/citron/keys/prod.keys plus optional title.keys (KeysDir = data root / "keys"); dev.keys and key_retail.bin accepted in the same directory
paths.naming: Exact key filenames are prod.keys and title.keys, with optional dev.keys and key_retail.bin; the source does not publish a canonical checksum for key files.
evidence: source:src/citron/main.cpp — "Verify that it contains prod.keys, title.keys and optionally, key_retail.bin"

paths.path: Switch firmware is NCA content installed into the NAND system partition: ~/.local/share/citron/nand/system/Contents/registered/ (user-partition mirror at nand/user/Contents/registered)
paths.naming: Installed NCA content is selected by the NAND firmware layout rather than a single BIOS filename; the source does not publish a canonical checksum for the installed firmware set.
Per-player control values persist in the [Controls] category; named profiles persist as input/<profile>.ini via profile read/save.

linux.notes: No save-state feature: fs_paths.h defines no states directory and src/core has no savestate module at commit 91bbce7231 (purpose 'states' therefore omitted). Citron is the yuzu-descendant codebase, so the yuzu conventions hold but with CITRON_DIR "citron" (not citron-emu). Lunchbox DB gap: firmware-rules.json binds manual:nintendo-switch-keys and manual:nintendo-switch-firmware to eden/ryubing/torzu rules but has no citron:* rules yet.

paths.path: ~/.config/citron/qt-config.ini with [Controls] mappings and ~/.config/citron/input/<profile>.ini profiles — macOS shares the POSIX branch, and unset XDG_* vars fall back to home/.config (no bundle-local data dir). Values are serialized ParamPackages (engine:keyboard,code:<integer>,toggle:0 or engine:sdl,joystick:<id>,button:<n>; axis:<n>,direction:<positive|negative>, with $0/$1/$2 escaping).
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp — POSIX (#else) branch applies to __APPLE__; GetDataDirectory falls back to GetHomeDirectory() / ".config" when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset
